title: Magelight UI
tagline: GPU-rendered web pages inside Skyrim SE, AE and VR. Runs SkyrimNet’s dashboard and chat and SeverActions’ menus, and lets any mod build its UI in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
description:
**Magelight UI** puts real web pages in Skyrim. Menus, HUD widgets and popups are drawn with Ultralight (a WebKit-based engine) straight onto the game's own Direct3D device, with mouse and keyboard routed to them.

### For players
- **One UI host for many mods.** SkyrimNet's dashboard and chat, SeverActions' menus and other Magelight mods all run on it.
- **Plays nicely with the game.** Hotkeys never fire over an engine menu, the console or a text field, and a key you type into a page never opens another mod's panel.
- **Type in any language.** Japanese, Chinese and Korean input is composed in the page, with the candidate list drawn beside the field.
- **Skyrim VR.** Pages float as panels you point at with the controller laser and click with the trigger, with an in-headset keyboard for text fields.
- **Light on resources.** Hidden pages pause, a page can be painted ahead of its first open, and memory is handed back when pages close.
- **Says what went wrong.** `Magelight.log` names a page that fails to load, a stalled frame or a crash in someone else's code.

### For mod authors
Three ways in, from no code to full control:
- **Manifest:** a `manifest.json` and your pages in `Data/Magelight/<YourMod>/`. No DLL, no scripts.
- **Papyrus:** open, close and talk to pages from quest and scene logic; host events arrive as ModEvents.
- **C++:** a versioned, append-only C API for SKSE plugins, with per-frame data, live textures (render an actor into a page) and UI-mode ownership.

Pages talk to the game through `window.magelight.send` / `on`. The `@magelight/sdk` and `@magelight/react` packages on npm add types, React hooks and a Vite plugin, and `npm create magelight-view MyMod` scaffolds a React mod. Docs and examples are on GitHub.

### Requirements
- **Skyrim SE 1.5.97:** SKSE64, Address Library (SE)
- **Skyrim AE 1.6.x / 1.7.x:** SKSE64 (2.3.0+ for 1.7.x), Address Library (AE)
- **Skyrim VR 1.4.15:** SKSEVR, VR Address Library
- **All:** Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable 2015-2022 (x64). Without it no page appears, and the log says `GetLastError=126`.

### Good to know
- Magelight ships its runtime under its own file names, so it coexists with other Ultralight-based mods, including PrismaUI.
- If a mod offers both, pick one host for its pages. Two hosts holding the mouse at once can show two cursors.
- Settings live in `Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\Magelight.json`; the log sits beside it.
- MIT licensed. Ultralight is used under its Free license.

changelog:
## Magelight UI 1.7.1

Includes everything from 1.7.0.

**Pages run on their own thread (flat Skyrim)**
- A page's scripts, layout and painting no longer take time out of the game's frame, so a heavy page costs its own frame rate, not yours
- A page stuck in a script freezes the pages, not the game, and you can still close it
- If something misbehaves, add `"pageThread": false` to `Magelight.json`. Skyrim VR is unchanged

**Pages at the main menu (flat Skyrim)**
- Pages can now open at the main menu when a mod asks for them there
- Other pages still start with the game, and aren't drawn over the main menu when you quit back to it

**Fixes**
- Long freeze when opening a heavy page, reported with Sanguine's Trade's Ledger
- Page rows turning black behind Community Shaders' frame generation
- Crash at start when the game folder's name isn't plain English
- Pages ignoring the keyboard until you alt-tab, seen on a few PCs
- A page that runs long no longer loses mouse releases or focus changes

**VR**
- Squeeze the grip while pointing at a page to grab it: it follows your laser, and the same hand's stick turns it or moves it closer and further away
- The game's red quill pointer no longer shows at the edges of a page

**For mod authors**
- On flat Skyrim, JS listeners and other render-thread callbacks now run on the page thread. Never touch game state from one: use `PostGameTask`
- UI mode requested at the main menu now opens your page, so **guard the request if your page needs a loaded game**
- `SetViewMainMenu` and the manifest key `"mainMenu"` make a main-menu page ahead of time
- API paths are UTF-8, so build page paths with `u8string()`
- New in VR: `kVRPlacementAtGaze` and `vr.atGaze` open a view where the player is looking

Thanks to **ColdSun** for the page thread!
